units.source_text: 我对夫人的怀疑，起初是一些小事引起的，然而随着这类琐屑之事的增多，怀疑也逐渐扎了根。

en.t: My suspicion of his wife was first aroused by small incidents, but as such trifles accumulated, that suspicion gradually took root.

units.source_text: 不知怎么搞的，我忽然想到，夫人莫非也和叔叔一样，企图让小姐和我接近吧？

en.t: For some reason, it suddenly occurred to me that perhaps his wife, like my uncle, was trying to bring the young lady and me closer together.

units.source_text: 一旦有了这个念头，原来觉得很热情的人，在我眼里立刻变成了狡黠的阴谋家，我痛苦地咬紧了嘴唇。

en.t: Once that thought had come to me, the person who had seemed so kind at once became, in my eyes, a cunning schemer, and I bit my lip in pain.

units.source_text: 夫人一开始就说过，因为家里人口少，太冷清了，才托人介绍房客的。

en.t: From the beginning, his wife had said that because there were so few people in the house and it was lonely, she had asked someone to introduce a boarder.

units.source_text: 我也不认为她说的是假话，当我们渐渐熟悉起来，无话不谈之后，我仍觉得这一点是不会错的。

en.t: I did not think she was lying, and even after we gradually became familiar enough to talk about anything, I still felt that this much was true.

units.source_text: 但是，她们的经济状况说不上多富裕，所以，从实际利益来看，同我结成特殊关系，对她们来说绝不吃亏。

en.t: But their financial circumstances could not be called very affluent, so from the standpoint of practical advantage, forming a special relationship with me would certainly be no loss to them.
